messages:
Alex: Morning team — quick triage check. Queue at 42 (was 28 overnight). Breakup: ~14 billing/duplicate charges, ~10 embedding failures, ~6 latency/timeout spikes in us-west-2. I'm taking the billing dup batch (SUP-4229 -> SUP-4238).

Maria: on it for embeddings. I flagged SUP-4211, SUP-4216, SUP-4220. Seeing 503s from embed-service starting ~03:10 UTC, error rate up ~7% — infra alert popped. I'll collect traces.

Jordan: I can take the latency spikes. Early signs point to autoscaler slowness on dedicated pools (nodes not coming up fast enough). @eng-infra can you eyeball the autoscale logs from 02:50–03:20?

Sam: For the duplicate-charge flow, recommend we tweak the refund macro to include the new policy link + a checklist for charge id verification. Draft macro below — please sanity check: 
```
Refund - Duplicate Charge macro v2
- Confirm charge_id & timestamp
- Check if duplicate via billing reconciliation tool: /billing check <charge_id>
- If duplicate, issue refund with reason: "duplicate_charge" and set refund_tier=expedited
- Paste refund link + policy: https://redwood.ai/support/refunds
- Add internal note: flagged-by:triage
```

Maria: Also adding an "investigate-embeds" step to macros so agents can easily attach logs. Suggested snippet to include: 
```
Collect embed logs:
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" \
  "https://api.redwood.ai/trace?query=embed-service&from=-15m" > embed-logs.json
```

Lee: quick ops note — I pushed a tiny macro repo patch (PR #134) to make template links open in new tab. Will ship Canary in ~30m.

triage-bot: [ALERT] embed-service 503 rate increased by 9% over baseline — incident INC-2026 created.

Alex: Plan for today — Maria will own embeddings, Jordan owns latency spikes, I'm on billing duplicates. Sam to land macro edits; Lee to monitor macro patch. If autoscaler doesn't stabilize within 1 hour, we'll escalate to eng-infra on-call. :thumbsup:

Maria: quick question — do we want the macro to include a standard customer-facing sentence about expected refund timing? I'm thinking: "Refunds generally process within 3–5 business days."

Alex: Yes add that sentence. Also add a short templated apology line for the customer.

Jordan: pinged @eng-infra in eng-infra channel, left logs and timestamps. I'll update here if I get ETA.

Lee: watching PR and infra alerts. If anything blocks support workflow, DM me and I can hotfix the macro template.

Sam: LGTM on the macro wording. I'll open a small PR with the refund sentence + apology line.

Alex: Thanks all. Update this thread with any new major changes or if you hit blockers that need backup.
